Name: Klee's Clothes Hair and Hat
Author: rena123rena
Description:
This is a FS module, you need to download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿, then go to Pierre to buy the hand mirror.
This module consists of five parts: Klee's hair, shirt, pants, hat, and expression.
This module is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7331]More Elegant Farmer body[/url] .
Klee is a character I like very much in the game Genshin Impact, so I made this costume beautification module, and I hope you like it.
﻿
